cards.text: I gave the empty desk an A.
Nobody sits there in my night class, but every week, homework appears on it.
The first essays copied my lessons. Then they started describing my flat.
Last week's described me marking papers at 2am, "with the curtains open."
So I gave it an A, and wrote "See me" across the top.
Tonight, its new essay wasn't on the desk. It was on my pillow.
Just one line, written in my own red pen.
"You asked to see me. Turn around."
